starters.hook: Who gets to expel a magician from an order — and who writes the history of it afterward?
Is energy the only life, and reason only its outward bound?
Is interior prayer something you practise, or something that happens to you?
Can a founder of a mystery religion be this funny in private, and does it cost her anything?
Does a new technology of distance destroy the sacred, or only the old way of keeping it?
Whose dream is it: the dreamer's, or the interpreter's?
Who is qualified to approve a book about the annihilation of the self?
Can you sort a person into a type without erasing the person?
Is defying the authorities a method, or only a temperament?
What does it take to collaborate for five years with someone you cannot control?

scenarios.label: The vote
scenarios.text: The Order meets tonight to vote on whether to expel a member who has published its rituals. He is in the next room, waiting to be called. The vote is yours to cast.

scenarios.label: A knock at midnight
scenarios.text: Someone has come to the door in the middle of the night asking to be taught. They will not say who sent them, and they are visibly frightened. What do you do?

artifact.text: A folded note, pushed under the door before the knocking began: "I was told you would not turn me away." No signature.

scenarios.label: The treasurer
scenarios.text: A small esoteric society discovers that its treasurer has been quietly selling members' confession letters to a newspaper. The members are divided. Some want him prosecuted; others want the matter kept inside the society.

scenarios.label: Ten years in
scenarios.text: A student has practised for ten years and has made little progress. Should the teacher tell them the truth, even if it discourages them?
